parsed.missing_from_rule: The rule does not include the 30-day time period qualifier; the policy allows 1 unit per 30 days, but the rule simply limits to 1 unit without specifying the time frame.
parsed.explanation: The rule omits the critical qualifier that the 1 unit limit applies per 30 days. As written, the rule would deny any claim for more than 1 unit ever, rather than per 30 days, which could result in wrongful denials for claims that are appropriately spaced over time.
